records.summary_text:
[CW note] From the CryptoWeeklies video of 26 August 2026.

[2026-08-26_XLM]  
Video Title: Stellar XLM Accumulation Zones: Finding the Support Levels Before the Rally  
Video ID: 2YgnVERRKEw  
Stellar (XLM) | Class: CRYPTO  

    Current Structure:  
    • Current weekly price sits at 18¢, just above the 20‑week SMA of roughly 18¢, indicating a marginally bullish stance.  
    • Composite risk score is 25, placing XLM in risk level 3 (20–30 range) and confirming its status in a bear‑market accumulation phase.  
    • Social sentiment remains low, with minimal narrative coverage, yet the overall risk model ranks XLM as the lowest‑risk breakout crypto at this time.  

    Macro Quantitative Risk:  
    • Time‑Weighted Average Price (TWAP) baseline hovers near 19¢, with the current premium at a modest +3% and a lifetime average of 19¢.  
    • Polynomial regression fair‑value band places XLM’s intrinsic value at 25¢, with a bottom regression of 13¢ and a peak of 17¢, underscoring a clear undervaluation relative to the market.  
    • Risk levels oscillate between 20–30, and the gravity risk metric sits at 24, slightly lower than peers but higher than Bitcoin or ETH.  

    Downside & Upside Targets:  
    • Machine‑learning forecasts set a 10‑week bare case at 13¢ and a boom case at 31¢, with a base projection near 20¢.  
    • Short‑term rally potential could lift XLM to 27–28¢ over the next 3–4 weeks, while a pullback would find support near the 20‑week SMA of 18¢.  
    • Cycle‑based bull target aligns with a 60% completion of the 4‑year cycle, suggesting a long‑term upside that could approach the Bitcoin peak forecast of $1–$143 (historical range).

records.title: Stellar (XLM): Golden Breakout Status Confirmed!
records.summary_text:
[CW note] From the CryptoWeeklies video of 21 July 2026.

[2026-07-21_XLM]  
Video Title: Stellar (XLM): Golden Breakout Status Confirmed!  
Video ID: hTaAV7lxIg4  
Stellar (XLM) | Class: CRYPTO  

Current Structure  
The live price sits at 19 cents, just 1% below its time‑weighted average baseline of 19 cents, indicating a marginally undervalued stance. The 90‑day momentum remains positive relative to the top‑20 cryptos, placing XLM in the “golden breakout” zone with less than medium risk. Key SMA levels cluster around the 22–31 cents accumulation territory, while the composite risk score flags a gravity risk of 24 (level 3). Social sentiment wordclouds show a surge in “euphoria” and “accumulation” keywords, reinforcing bullish chatter.  

Macro Quantitative Risk  
TWAP baselines align with the 19‑cent average, and the model assigns a risk level of 1 when below this baseline, escalating to 3 as the price approaches the 31‑cent upper bound. Regression‑derived fair‑value bands place XLM’s overvaluation zone between 55–80 cents, with a projected max euphoria range expanding to 90–130 cents by 2029 if the current trajectory persists. Undervaluation residuals are evident in the 22–31 cents accumulation corridor, while the 55–80 cents band signals a potential overvaluation threshold.  

Downside & Upside Targets  
Machine‑learning forecasts project a base case of 18–20 cents, a counter‑trend rally to 30–32 cents, and a 10‑week downturn floor at 12 cents. Panic‑drawdown support is identified near 14 cents, with a secondary floor at 12 cents per the model’s gravity risk assessment. Macro moving‑average supports suggest a short‑term target of 19 cents and a long‑term bull case of 1.06 dollars (≈ 6× current price) by 2029, while a higher bull stretch reaches 1.43 dollars (≈ 8× current price).
